wiki.title: Margaret Arney
wiki.extract: Margaret Michele Arney (née Tully; born June 17, 1969) is an American nonprofit consultant, educator, and Democratic politician from Milwaukee County, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 18th Assembly district since 2025. She served on the city council of Wauwatosa, Wisconsin, from 2022 to 2026. She was Wauwatosa's first African American city councilmember.
